# Appendix A. Calibration runs on the RTX 5090

<!-- Generated by `npm run dev:docs` from the repository data. Do not edit by hand. -->

Calibration runs on one RTX 5090 (32 GB; Windows 11 + WSL2, vLLM 0.31.0 in Docker), dummy weights, fp8 KV cache. Runs disturbed by other programs using the CPU are kept with the reason and excluded from the fit. Reproduce with `npm run dev:speed` and `npm run dev:measure` (scripts/dev/README.md).

GPU time of this calibration: 1.7 h over 26 runs (7 speed runs excluded), plus engine start-up.
